q: The old car badly _____ repairs before it could be driven safely on the highway.

translation: 这辆旧车在能安全驶上公路之前， badly 需要 修理。

q: The professor _____ several important details that most students had overlooked in their essays.

translation: 教授注意到了几个重要细节，大多数学生在论文中都忽略了它们。

q: We immediately _____ a strange smell coming from the kitchen after we turned on the heater.

translation: 打开暖气后，我们立即注意到厨房传来一股奇怪的气味。

q: She gently _____ her sick grandmother back to health over the long winter months.
explain: nurse n. 护士 / v. 护理。
translation: 在漫长的冬季里，她悉心护理生病的祖母，使她恢复了健康。

q: The official report _____ all the volunteers who contributed to the success of the community event.
explain: name n. 名字 / v. 命名。
translation: 官方报告列出了所有为社区活动成功做出贡献的志愿者。

q: He always _____ politely when greeting his neighbors early in the morning at the front door.
explain: nod n. 点头 / v. 点头。
translation: 他一大早在前门和邻居打招呼时，总是礼貌地点头示意。

q: The experienced fisherman _____ a large catch of fresh tuna before the sun rose over the horizon.
explain: net n. 网 / v. 净赚。
translation: 这位经验丰富的渔夫在太阳升起地平线之前就网住了大量新鲜金枪鱼。

q: She used a heavy hammer to _____ the wooden picture frame securely to the wall.
explain: nail n. 指甲 / v. 钉住。
translation: 她用一把重锤子把木相框牢牢地钉在墙上。

q: The mountain road began to _____ dramatically as we approached the highest point of the pass.
explain: narrow adj. 狭窄的 / v. 使变窄。
translation: 当我们接近山口最高点时，山路开始急剧变窄。

q: As the holiday season _____, the shopping malls became increasingly crowded with excited customers.
explain: near adj. 近的 / adv. 在近处 / prep. 在…附近 / v. 接近。
translation: 随着假期临近，购物中心里越来越挤满了兴奋的顾客。

q: The romantic couple walked along the beach and _____ affectionately under the silver moonlight.
explain: neck n. 脖子 / v. 搂着脖子亲吻。
translation: 这对浪漫的情侣沿着海滩散步，在银色月光下深情地搂抱亲吻。

q: The union leaders met for three days to _____ better working conditions for all factory employees.
explain: negotiate v. 谈判，协商。
translation: 工会领袖们会面了三天，为所有工厂员工谈判争取更好的工作条件。

q: Every spring, the swallows return to _____ in the old barn behind my grandparents' farmhouse.
explain: nest n. 巢 / v. 筑巢。
translation: 每年春天，燕子都会回到我祖父母农舍后面的旧谷仓里筑巢。

q: It is important to _____ with professionals in your field to find better career opportunities.
explain: network n. 网络 / v. 建立网络。
translation: 与你所在领域的专业人士建立人脉对于找到更好的职业机会非常重要。

q: The trained dog can _____ out hidden drugs at the airport with remarkable accuracy.
explain: nose n. 鼻子 / v. 嗅，闻。
translation: 这只受过训练的狗能够以惊人的准确度在机场嗅出隐藏的毒品。

q: Please _____ each page of the report clearly so that readers can find sections quickly.
explain: number n. 数字，数量 / v. 编号。
translation: 请清楚地给报告的每一页编号，以便读者能快速找到各章节。

q: The entire _____ celebrated with fireworks when the team won the world championship.
explain: nation n. 国家，民族。
translation: 当国家队赢得世界冠军时，整个国家都用烟花庆祝。

q: The Grand Canyon is considered a _____ treasure that belongs to all American citizens.
explain: national adj. 国家的，民族的 / n. 国民。
translation: 大峡谷被认为属于所有美国公民的国家瑰宝。

q: Please write your _____ and passport number on the top of the application form.
explain: nationality n. 国籍，民族。
translation: 请在申请表顶部填写你的国籍和护照号码。

q: She returned to her _____ country after living and working abroad for more than fifteen years.
explain: native n. 本地人 / adj. 本地的，天生的。
translation: 在国外生活和工作了十五年后，她回到了自己的祖国。

q: The disaster caused severe damage to the _____ environment and wildlife in the coastal region.
explain: natural adj. 自然的，天然的。
translation: 这场灾难对沿海地区的自然环境和野生动物造成了严重破坏。

q: We spent the entire weekend enjoying the beauty of _____ in the peaceful mountain valley.
explain: nature n. 自然，本性。
translation: 我们整个周末都在宁静的山谷中享受大自然的美景。

q: He joined the _____ immediately after graduating from the military academy with honors.
explain: navy n. 海军。
translation: 他以优异的成绩从军事学院毕业后立即加入了海军。

q: We found a lovely Italian restaurant _____ where we could sit and enjoy a relaxing dinner.
explain: nearby adj. 附近的 / adv. 在附近。
translation: 我们在附近找到一家可爱的意大利餐厅，可以坐下来享受轻松的晚餐。

q: It took us _____ three hours to finish cleaning the entire house from top to bottom.
explain: nearly adv. 几乎，差不多。
translation: 我们花了将近三个小时才把整栋房子从上到下打扫干净。

q: Her office desk was always _____ and organized, with every document in its proper place.
explain: neat adj. 整洁的，整齐的。
translation: 她的办公桌总是整洁有序，每份文件都在恰当的位置。

q: It is absolutely _____ to bring a valid identification card to enter the government building.
explain: necessary adj. 必要的，必需的。
translation: 进入政府大楼时携带有效的身份证明是绝对必要的。

q: The doctor used a very thin _____ to draw blood from the patient's arm gently.
explain: needle n. 针。
translation: 医生用一根很细的针轻轻从病人手臂上抽血。

q: The test results came back completely _____, which was a huge relief for the worried family.
explain: negative adj. 消极的，否定的 / n. 否定，负数。
translation: 检测结果完全呈阴性，这让担忧的家人大大松了一口气。

q: Our friendly _____ often brings us fresh vegetables from his beautiful garden in the summer.
explain: neighbour n. 邻居。
translation: 夏天，我们友好的邻居经常从他那美丽的花园里给我们带来新鲜蔬菜。

q: The children feel very safe playing outside in this quiet and peaceful residential _____.
explain: neighbourhood n. 街区，附近。
translation: 孩子们在这个安静祥和的住宅街区外面玩耍时感到非常安全。

q: My _____ just started his first year studying engineering at a top university in Boston.

translation: 我的侄子刚开始在波士顿一所顶尖大学学习工程学的第一年。

q: She felt extremely _____ before her very first job interview in the big city.
explain: nervous adj. 紧张的，焦虑的。
translation: 在大城市第一次工作面试前，她感到极度紧张。

q: I have _____ seen such a spectacular sunset over the ocean in my entire life.
explain: never adv. 从不，绝不。
translation: 我一生中从未见过如此壮观的海上日落。

q: The weather forecast was terrible for the outdoor concert; _____, thousands of fans still attended.
explain: nevertheless adv. 然而，不过。
translation: 天气预报说户外音乐会天气很糟糕，尽管如此，成千上万的歌迷仍然前来参加。

q: We recently moved into a brand _____ apartment with a wonderful view of the river.
explain: new adj. 新的。
translation: 我们最近搬进了一套全新的公寓，可以欣赏到河流的美妙景色。

q: The breaking _____ about the earthquake spread rapidly across all social media platforms.
explain: news n. 新闻，消息。
translation: 关于地震的突发新闻迅速在所有社交媒体平台上传播开来。

q: I still enjoy reading the morning _____ while drinking a hot cup of coffee at breakfast.
explain: newspaper n. 报纸。
translation: 我仍然喜欢在早餐时喝着热咖啡阅读早报报纸。

q: The _____ train to London is scheduled to depart from platform three in approximately fifteen minutes.
explain: next adj. 下一个的 / adv. 接下来 / prep. 靠近。

q: It was very _____ of you to help me carry all these heavy shopping bags upstairs.

translation: 你帮我提这些沉重的购物袋上楼，真是太好了。

q: My _____ baked a delicious chocolate cake for my birthday party last weekend.

translation: 我的侄女上周末为我的生日派对烤了一个美味的巧克力蛋糕。

q: The city is absolutely beautiful at _____ when all the street lights are turned on.
explain: night n. 夜晚。
translation: 当所有街灯亮起时，这座城市在夜晚绝对美丽。

q: The king rewarded the brave knight with a _____ title and a large piece of fertile land.

q: The loud construction _____ from next door disturbed the entire neighborhood early this morning.

translation: 今天早上，隔壁传来的嘈杂施工噪音打扰了整个街区。

translation: 我煮了一些速食面条当午餐，因为我急着完成工作。

translation: 重要的董事会会议定于中午开始，预计持续约两个小时。

q: The _____ part of the country receives much more rainfall during the summer months.

translation: 这位著名的小说家明天将在当地图书馆签售他的最新作品。

translation: 许多国家仍在争论核能在其气候政策计划中的未来。

q: A small squirrel carefully hid a single _____ in the ground to save it for the cold winter.

translation: 一只小松鼠小心翼翼地把一颗坚果埋藏在地下，为寒冷的冬天储备食物。

translation: 良好的营养对于儿童健康成长和发育绝对是至关重要的。
